As Amag Pharmaceuticals (AMAG) Valuation Rose, Sabby Management Increased Stake by $503,828; Atalanta Sosnoff Capital Holding in Facebook (FB) Has Decreased by $6.22 Million as Stock Value Declined
May 20, 2018 - By Darrin Black
Hal Mintz increased its stake in Amag Pharmaceuticals Inc (AMAG) by 48.38% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sabby Management Llc bought 38,756 shares as the company’s stock rose 33.69% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Hal Mintz held 118,864 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.58 million, up from 80,108 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sabby Management Llc who had been investing in Amag Pharmaceuticals Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $846.15 million market cap company. It closed at $24.65 lastly. It is down 16.25% downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.80% the S&P500.
Atalanta Sosnoff Capital Llc decreased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 6.52% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Atalanta Sosnoff Capital Llc sold 35,359 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.10% with the market. The institutional investor held 506,875 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $89.44 million, down from 542,234 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Atalanta Sosnoff Capital Llc who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $528.79B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.59% or $1.08 $182.68. About 10.38 million shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 8.48% uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.07% the S&P500.
